mapper.select: select count(*) from exhibition_order o where o.use_time is not null and o.use_time >= #{start} and o.use_time < #{end}

select count(*) from ( select e.id from exhibition_order o join exhibition e on e.id = o.exhibition_id join gallery g on g.id = o.gallery_id
group by e.id ) t
select ifnull(sum(o.quantity), 0) from exhibition_order o join exhibition e on e.id = o.exhibition_id join gallery g on g.id = o.gallery_id

select count(*) from ( select date(o.pay_time), e.id from exhibition_order o join exhibition e on e.id = o.exhibition_id join gallery g on g.id = o.gallery_id
group by date(o.pay_time), e.id ) t

select date(o.pay_time) as stat_date, e.id as exhibition_id, e.title as exhibition_title, ifnull(sum(o.quantity), 0) as sold_count, ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) as daily_revenue from exhibition_order o join exhibition e on e.id = o.exhibition_id join gallery g on g.id = o.gallery_id
group by date(o.pay_time), e.id, e.title order by stat_date desc, sold_count desc, e.id asc limit #{dto.offset}, #{dto.limit}
